stem: Choose the word closest in meaning to METICULOUS.
explanation: Meticulous means showing great attention to detail.

stem: Which law sets the national program for ecological solid waste management?
explanation: R.A. 9003 is the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000. (R.A. 8749 is the Clean Air Act, R.A. 9275 the Clean Water Act and R.A. 9729 the Climate Change Act.)
